component.name: Details
component.description: A native disclosure widget that shows and hides its content when the summary is activated.

body_theme.description: Background theme for the full-width section around the disclosure. Also sets the summary, chevron, content and focus ring colours, so it changes more than the background alone.

size.description: Size of the summary text. The chevron and the content indent scale with it.

summary.description: The always-visible label. Write it so a reader can tell what is hidden without opening it.

content.description: The content revealed when the summary is activated. Printed whether or not the disclosure is open, since paper cannot be expanded.
content.value: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Fusce dictum efficitur egestas. Aenean sed pretium mauris.

id_field.description: Anchor for linking directly to this disclosure, used as the element id. Leave empty to fall back to a generated id.
